notes.title: 5/26/2020 update
notes.notes:
We've addressed a display issue encountered while playing the game on certain versions of Windows 10 and Steam.

The previous work around was running the game under compatibility mode, but this update should enable it to run normally.

Just let the game auto-update itself to apply.

notes.title: 11/10/2019 Update
notes.notes:
This update fixes various issues including:

 Maricarmen's nickname has been changed to Mari
 The spelling of Maya's name has been changed to Maja
 Several image issues have been fixed
 Various other minor issues have been resolved

Please let the game auto-update itself to apply.
